Class TreeTraverser

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.TreeTraverser
Direct Known Subclasses:
SingleThreadTCSolver, SingleThreadTMVASolver
public abstract class TreeTraverser extends Object
Tree traverser abstract class which implements generic single-threaded tree traversal, leaving the actual node computations to the extending class.
Author:
Ben Homer, 2014.
